pitch.heading: Down the coast road to Sennet
pitch.text: Sennet is a port city in three storeys. On the bay, the quays and glass-houses, and on the headland the House of Doors, whose doors open on the elemental planes. Over the cloud-line above it, Cloudgate, a hill of the old city lifted into the sky two hundred years ago, where it is always a fine afternoon. Under the bay, the Whelm, the lower town the sea came into when the hill went up, where the merfolk live now among the drowned shop-signs. Twelve days ago the Rector of the House of Doors proclaimed the first Grand Tour in two hundred years: whoever brings her the four petals of the Rose of the Winds will be first through the Door of Doors. The same night a young man went over the balustrade of Cloudgate in the fog. You have eighteen coin, and the coast road under your feet.
